MEBL/CS/PSX-17/137/2022 
PUBLICATION OF NOTICES FOR THE CREDIT/DISPATCH OF 10% BONUS SHARE 
CERTIFICATES OF MEEZAN BANK LIMITED 
Dear Sir, 
This is further to our earlier letter No. MEBL/CS/PSX-17/135/2022 dated September 21, 2022 concerning 
the Dispatch of 10% Bonus Shares Certificates / Credit in CDC sub accounts of entitled shareholders of 
Meezan Bank Limited. 
In this connection, we would like to inform you that the notices for the credit of said 10% Bonus Shares are 
published nationwide today i.e. Thursday, September 22, 2022 in two newspapers namely "Business 
Recorder " and "The Daily Express" in English and Urdu languages respectively. Copies of the same are 
enclosed for your reference and record. 
Please inform the THE Certificate Holders of the Exchange accordingly. 
Yours Sincerely, 
Muhammad Sohail Khan 
Company Secretary 
Encls: As above 
Meezan Bank Ltd. 
Head Office: Meezan House, C-25, Estate Avenue, SITE, Karachi - Pakistan.
